game_concept: A card battler set in Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing, a river of molten rock: the volcanologist must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Lava River Crossing open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing: a river of molten rock
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read n. Display Above when n > 3; otherwise display At or below. Test dataset 8: {'n': 1}; {'n': 6}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Modulo Gate' (Week 2 slot 3), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Lava River Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about gates_open to power up the volcanologist and open the forge anvil.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
source_game_title: Modulo Gate – Lava River Crossing Streak
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
